summary: Propose a narrowly bounded, later-ratified legacy continuation-writer floor: extract post-hoc selected continuation-only rows from immutable B0/B1/B2 snapshots; compare BOS-only versus an exact neutral-chat-prefix training package and an untrained base on a sealed content-disjoint one-action panel. The floor tests parametric transport/reinforcement and strict executable-interface retention only, while preserving the broader organism thesis and prohibiting attribution of discovery or recurrent learning to the LoRA.
system_thesis: The organism learns across recurrent scales: lived goal-directed action produces real outcomes; dream-time processes locally re-express and connect retained episodes; parametric consolidation can transport selected regularities; later goal-conditioned retrieval, composition, planning, and revision use—but do not by themselves constitute—those memories; and later thinking/outcomes may inform subsequent dream cycles. Credit belongs to the complete organism when behavior requires its context, action interface, environment, and feedback loop. This isolated floor deliberately removes retrieval, multi-step planning, revision, and feedback, so any observed effect is attributable only to the evaluated frozen cell-plus-serving-and-environment package, never to LoRA discovery or complete-organism continual learning.
title: Legacy continuation-writer floor: bounded continuation/action transport assay
